name: todos
description: Universal task management for AI coding agents. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (todos-serve) + generated SDK. One data-backend switch, two arms: the server stores in the local SQLite file by default, or in PostgreSQL when HASNA_TODOS_DATABASE_URL is set (serving the authenticated /v1 API per Amendment A1, API-key auth via @hasna/contracts). The client connects to its local SQLite file or to the /v1 authority over HTTP; it never opens Postgres directly.
